apply_spectral_norm: apply spectral normalization to a PyTorch module parameter using power iteration to stabilize GAN training
remove_spectral_norm: remove spectral normalization reparameterization from a PyTorch module and restore the original weight parameter
compute_spectral_norm_weight: compute the spectrally normalized weight tensor using power iteration to approximate the singular vectors u and v
save_spectral_norm_state: save spectral normalization version metadata into state dict local metadata for checkpoint compatibility
load_spectral_norm_state: load spectral normalization state dict with backward-compatible handling of version 0 and version 1 formats
